en: Changed managed `extraKnownMarketplaces` take-overs from an undeclared source: saved data is set aside for `cleanupPeriodDays`, and options and secrets until `claude plugin restore-set-aside`
zh: 变更受管 `extraKnownMarketplaces` 对未声明来源的接管：已保存的数据保留 `cleanupPeriodDays` 天，选项和密钥保留至执行 `claude plugin restore-set-aside`
